jamie: customer hit double billing when stream resumed to a different backend after a toolcall finalized. ledger shows overlapping tokens.

olivia: route? traces? :eyes:

jamie: route=router-eu-mux trace=0xabad1dea session=cli-7777. ledger rows look like: toolcall confirmed at offsets 200..240, stream confirmed later with offsets 220..250

sandeep: sounds like backend-local dedupe failed. propose router emit a short-lived global_session_key on handshake so dedupe can cross backend boundaries

maria: short-term: console should mark "suspect overlap" and give ops a rollback button. also add a mux canary to disable handoffs for sessions with in-flight toolcalls

olivia: agree. Sandeep, add POC for global key TTL 5m. Mari, mock dashboard tile with overlap counts by route and plan tier

billing-bot: noted: 1 customer affected, ~56 tokens. ticket INC-5012 opened.

jamie: i'll attach traces to the ticket. keep updates here. :pray:
